key_insight: Skill Adapter personalizes reusable agent skills and dynamically routes them as task conditions change.
engineering_relevance: It offers a way to adapt shared agent procedures to user-specific tools and requirements while keeping skill selection responsive during long tasks.
method: Distill user requirements and execution feedback into Adapters linked to general-purpose skills.
Route skills and Adapters into a task-level online library, preloading candidates and rechecking applicability when inputs become known.
Use reinforcement learning to optimize modification and routing decisions.
evidence_signal: Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and SkillsBench, Skill Adapter reports an average 11.43-percentage-point success-rate gain over SkillRL, lower mean execution time on all three benchmarks, and a retained performance advantage with 1,000 skills.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify training costs or routing overhead, leaving deployment resource requirements unclear.
paper_title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
